name: store-file
question: Store a file unchanged inside the project (a generated diff, a Codex prompt or answer actually used), byte for byte, with its SHA-256 checked before and after the copy; for a Codex events file it also reports the thread id and the sum of its turn usages.
choices: docs/validation/v0.5.12/tools/store_file.py <source> <destination>, imported unchanged from v0.5.12; the destination must not exist. Offline. It emits no case value.
